scope: Retained etymology excerpts; partial source passages remain excerpts, not complete histories.

reviews.en: From Middle English accesse, acces, borrowed from Middle French acces (“attack, onslaught”) or from its source Latin accessus, perfect passive participle of accēdō
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语accesse、acces，借自中古法语acces（袭击、猛攻），或来自其拉丁语源accessus，即accēdō的完成被动分词……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin admissio, admissionis; compare French admission. See admit.
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语admissio、admissionis；可与法语admission比较，另见admit。

reviews.en: From Middle English admitten, amitten, borrowed from Old French admettre, amettre (“to admit”), from Latin admittō (“to allow entrance, inlet”, literally “to send
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语admitten、amitten，借自古法语admettre、amettre（准许进入），再源于拉丁语admittō（允许进入、引入），字面义中包含“送”……

reviews.en: From Middle English advocat, advoket, from Old French advocat, from Latin advocātus (“an advocate”), from the substantivization of the perfect passive participle of
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语advocat、advoket，经古法语advocat追溯至拉丁语advocātus（辩护人）；它由完成被动分词名词化而来……

reviews.en: From Middle English allocate (the common first word of writs authorizing payment), from Medieval Latin allocātum, substantivized from the nominative neuter singular of
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语allocate，这是授权付款令状中常见的第一个词；再源于中世纪拉丁语allocātum，由中性单数主格形式名词化而来……

reviews.en: From Middle French allocacion, from Medieval Latin allocātiō. By surface analysis, allocate + -ion.
reviews.zh: 来自中古法语allocacion，再源于中世纪拉丁语allocātiō；按词形可分析为allocate + -ion。

reviews.en: From New Latin anachronismus, from Ancient Greek ἀναχρονισμός (anakhronismós), from ἀναχρονίζομαι (anakhronízomai, “referring to the wrong time”), from ἀνά (aná, “up against”) +
reviews.zh: 来自新拉丁语anachronismus，追溯至古希腊语anachronismós和anakhronízomai（指向错误的时代），其中包含aná（向上抵着、反向）……

reviews.en: From aqua- + culture.
reviews.zh: 由aqua-与culture构成。

reviews.en: From Latin aqua marīna (“sea water”), adjective form from mare (“sea”).
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语aqua marīna（海水）；其中形容词形式源于mare（海）。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin aquārium, neuter of aquārius (“of or pertaining to water”), from aqua + -arium. Doublet of ewer; see also Aquarius. Also
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语aquārium，即aquārius（与水有关的）的中性形式，由aqua + -arium构成；它与ewer同源异形，另可参看Aquarius……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French aquatique (“living in water”), from Latin aquaticus (“relating to water”), from aqua (“water”).
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语aquatique（水中生活的），再源于拉丁语aquaticus（与水有关的），其基础为aqua（水）。

reviews.en: Formed from Latin aqua + -ous (or from Medieval Latin aqueus), partly the analogy of Middle French aqueux (itself actually from Latin aquosus).
reviews.zh: 由拉丁语aqua + -ous构成，或来自中世纪拉丁语aqueus；部分受中古法语aqueux的类推影响，后者实际源于拉丁语aquosus。

reviews.en: From aqui- + -fer.
reviews.zh: 由aqui-与-fer构成。

reviews.en: From a- + synchronous.
reviews.zh: 由a-与synchronous构成。

reviews.en: From Latin attractus, past participle of attrahere (“to draw to, attract”), from ad (“to”) + trahere (“to draw”).
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语attractus，即attrahere（拉向、吸引）的过去分词，由ad（向）+ trahere（拉）构成。

reviews.en: From Middle English attraccioun, from Old French attraction, from Latin attractio from past participle of attrahō (= ad + trahō), equivalent to attract
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语attraccioun，经古法语attraction追溯至拉丁语attractio，后者源于attrahō（由ad + trahō构成）的过去分词；与attract的构词相关……

reviews.en: From Middle French attractif, from Late Latin attractīvus, equivalent to attract + -ive.
reviews.zh: 来自中古法语attractif，再源于晚期拉丁语attractīvus；相当于attract + -ive。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French audible, from Late Latin audibilis, from Latin audire (“to hear”).
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语audible，经晚期拉丁语audibilis追溯至拉丁语audire（听）。

reviews.en: From Middle English audience, from Middle French audience, from Old French audience, from Latin audientia, from present participle audiēns (“hearing”), from verb audiō
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语audience，经中古法语和古法语audience追溯至拉丁语audientia，源自现在分词audiēns（正在听），对应动词audiō……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French audicion, from Latin audītiō, from audiō (“to hear”).
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语audicion，再源于拉丁语audītiō，其动词基础是audiō（听）。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin audītōrium, from audītōrius (“pertaining to hearing”). Equivalent to auditory + -ium.
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语audītōrium，源于audītōrius（与听觉有关的）；可与auditory + -ium对应理解。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin audītōrius (“pertaining to a hearer or hearing”), from audiō (“to hear”) + -tōrius (“-tory”, adjectival suffix).
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语audītōrius（与听者或听觉有关的），由audiō（听）与形容词后缀-tōrius（相当于-tory）构成。

reviews.en: From auto- + biography.
reviews.zh: 由auto-与biography构成。

reviews.en: From auto- + focus.
reviews.zh: 由auto-与focus构成。

reviews.en: From Latin autographum, in turn from Ancient Greek αὐτόγραφον (autógraphon, “a writing in one’s own hand”). Equivalent to auto- + -graph.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语autographum，再源于古希腊语autógraphon（亲手写下的文字）；可分析为auto- + -graph。

reviews.en: Borrowed from New Latin automaticus, from Classical Latin automatum (“automaton”) + -icus (adjectival suffix), from Ancient Greek αὐτόματον (autómaton), neuter of αὐτόματος (autómatos,
reviews.zh: 借自新拉丁语automaticus，来自古典拉丁语automatum（自动装置）与形容词后缀-icus，并追溯至古希腊语autómaton，即autómatos的中性形式……

reviews.en: From automatic + -ion or automaton + -ion; coined by a Ford Executive Vice President, Delmar S. Harder, in the 1940s.
reviews.zh: 由automatic + -ion或automaton + -ion构成；原文记载，福特公司执行副总裁Delmar S. Harder在20世纪40年代创造了这个词。

reviews.en: From French automobile, from Ancient Greek αὐτός (autós, “self”) + French mobile (“moving”), from Latin mōbilis (“movable”), equivalent to auto- (“self”) + mobile.
reviews.zh: 来自法语automobile，由古希腊语autós（自身）与法语mobile（移动的）构成，后者源于拉丁语mōbilis（可移动的）；相当于auto- + mobile。

reviews.en: From autonomy + -ous.
reviews.zh: 由autonomy与-ous构成。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Ancient Greek αὐτονομῐ́ᾱ (autonomĭ́ā, “freedom to use its own laws, independence”), from αὐτόνομος (autónomos, “living under one's own laws, independent”) +
reviews.zh: 借自古希腊语autonomĭ́ā（依自己的法律行事的自由、独立），源自autónomos（依自己的法律生活的、独立的）……

reviews.en: Partial calque of Italian bancarotta (literally “a broken bench”), from banca (“bank”, literally “bench”) + rotta (“broken, rupted”), which refers to an out-of-business
reviews.zh: 部分仿译意大利语bancarotta，字面义为“破了的长凳”，由banca（银行，字面义为长凳）与rotta（破裂的）构成；后面的原文接着谈及停业……

reviews.en: From Middle English benediccion, from Ecclesiastical Latin benedictio, benedictionis, from benedictus (“blessed; well spoken of”). Doublet of benison.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语benediccion，源于教会拉丁语benedictio、benedictionis及benedictus（受到祝福的、受称赞的）；与benison同源异形。

reviews.en: From Middle English benefactor, borrowed from Medieval Latin benefactor (“he who bestows a favor”), from Latin benefaciō (“benefit someone”), from bene (“good”) +
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语benefactor，借自中世纪拉丁语benefactor（施惠者），再源于拉丁语benefaciō（使某人受益），其中包含bene（好）……

reviews.en: From Late Latin beneficiālis (“beneficial”), from Latin beneficium (“benefit, favor, kindness”).
reviews.zh: 来自晚期拉丁语beneficiālis（有益的），再源于拉丁语beneficium（益处、恩惠、善意）。

reviews.en: From Latin beneficiarius (“enjoying a favor, granted a privilege”) from beneficium (“benefit”), perhaps via or influenced by French bénéficiaire (“beneficiary”). Indirectly, by way
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语beneficiarius（享有恩惠或特权的），源于beneficium（益处），可能经由法语bénéficiaire（受益人）传入或受到其影响……

reviews.en: From Late Middle English benefytt, benefett, alteration (due to Latin bene-) of benfet, bienfet, bienfait (“good or noble deed”), from Anglo-Norman benfet (“well-done”),
reviews.zh: 来自晚期中古英语benefytt、benefett，是benfet、bienfet、bienfait（善举或高尚行为）受到拉丁语bene-影响后的变形；其前身为盎格鲁—诺曼语benfet（做得好的）……

reviews.en: Circa 1400, original sense “good will, disposition to do good”, Old French benivolence from Latin benevolentia (also directly from Latin), literally “good will”,
reviews.zh: 约在1400年出现，原义是“善意、愿意行善的倾向”；古法语benivolence来自拉丁语benevolentia，也可能直接借自拉丁语，其字面义为善意……

reviews.en: From Old French benevolent, borrowed from Latin benevolēns ("benevolent"). Displaced native Old English welwillende (literally well-wishing).
reviews.zh: 来自古法语benevolent，借自拉丁语benevolēns（仁慈的）；它取代了本土古英语welwillende，后者字面义为“怀有善意的”。

reviews.en: From bio- + degradable.
reviews.zh: 由bio-与degradable构成。

reviews.en: Borrowed from New Latin biographia, from Ancient Greek βιογραφίᾱ (biographíā), from βίος (bíos, life) + -γραφία (-graphía, writing).
reviews.zh: 借自新拉丁语biographia，再源于古希腊语biographíā，由bíos（生命）与-graphía（书写）构成。

reviews.en: From biology + -ical.
reviews.zh: 由biology与-ical构成。

reviews.en: From bio- + luminescence.
reviews.zh: 由bio-与luminescence构成。

reviews.en: Borrowed from German Biosphäre, coined by Austrian geologist Eduard Suess in 1875. By surface analysis, bio- + -sphere.
reviews.zh: 借自德语Biosphäre，原文记载该词由奥地利地质学家Eduard Suess于1875年创造；按词形可分析为bio- + -sphere。

reviews.en: From bio- + technology.
reviews.zh: 由bio-与technology构成。

reviews.en: From chronical, from Old French cronike, from Latin chronicus, from Ancient Greek χρονικός (khronikós, “of time”), from χρόνος (khrónos, “time”). By surface analysis,
reviews.zh: 来自chronical，经古法语cronike、拉丁语chronicus追溯至古希腊语khronikós（与时间有关的）及khrónos（时间）；原文随后进行词形分析……

reviews.en: From Middle English cronicle, cronycle, from Anglo-Norman cronicle, from Old French cronike, from Latin chronica, from Ancient Greek χρονικός (khronikós, “of or concerning
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语cronicle、cronycle，经盎格鲁—诺曼语cronicle、古法语cronike及拉丁语chronica，追溯至古希腊语khronikós……

reviews.en: From chrono- + -logical or chronology + -ical.
reviews.zh: 由chrono- + -logical或chronology + -ical构成。

reviews.en: From chrono- (“relating to time”) + -logy (“study of, account of”), after New Latin chronologia from Ancient Greek χρόνος (khrónos, “time”) + λόγος
reviews.zh: 由chrono-（与时间有关）与-logy（研究、记述）构成，仿照新拉丁语chronologia；其来源包含古希腊语khrónos（时间）与lógos……

reviews.en: Inherited from Middle English committen, itself borrowed from Latin committō (“to bring together, join, compare, commit (a wrong), incur, give in charge, etc.”),
reviews.zh: 继承自中古英语committen，后者借自拉丁语committō，含有聚集、连接、比较、犯错、招致、托付等意义……

reviews.en: From Middle English [Term?], from Old French conceder, from Latin concēdō (“give way, yield”), from con- (“wholly”) + cēdō (“to yield, give way,
reviews.zh: 原文将其追溯到中古英语，但未给出该阶段的具体词形；随后经古法语conceder追溯至拉丁语concēdō（退让），由con-（完全）与cēdō（让步、退让）构成……

reviews.en: From Late Latin conductus (“defense, escort”), from Latin conductus, perfect passive participle of condūcō (“bring together”); see also conduce. Displaced native Old English
reviews.zh: 来自晚期拉丁语conductus（防卫、护送），再源于拉丁语conductus，即condūcō（聚集）的完成被动分词；另见conduce。原文随后提及被取代的古英语词……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French conductour, from Old French conduitor, from Latin conductor.
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语conductour，经古法语conduitor追溯至拉丁语conductor。

reviews.en: From Middle English conformen, borrowed from Middle French and Anglo-Norman conformer, from Latin conformāre (“to mould, to shape after”).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语conformen，借自中古法语及盎格鲁—诺曼语conformer，再源于拉丁语conformāre（塑造、照样成形）。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin cōnstrūctus, from cōnstruō (“to heap together”), from com- (“together”) + struō (“to heap up, pile”). Doublet of construe.
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语cōnstrūctus，源于cōnstruō（堆在一起），由com-（一起）与struō（堆积）构成；与construe同源异形。

reviews.en: From Middle English construccioun, construction, from Old French construction, from Latin cōnstructiō, from cōnstruere. Morphologically construct + -ion.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语construccioun、construction，经古法语construction追溯至拉丁语cōnstructiō及cōnstruere；按构词可分析为construct + -ion。

reviews.en: From Latin cōnstrūctīvus. By surface analysis, construct + -ive.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语cōnstrūctīvus；按词形可分析为construct + -ive。

reviews.en: From Middle English, from Middle French contracter, from Latin contractum, past participle of contrahere (“to bring together, to bring about, to conclude a
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语，经中古法语contracter追溯至拉丁语contractum，即contrahere的过去分词；该动词含聚集、促成、缔结等意义……

reviews.en: PIE word *ḱóm From Late Middle English contraccioun, contraxion (“spasm, contraction; constriction, shrinking; act of pressing together”), from Old French contraction (modern French
reviews.zh: 原文列出原始印欧语词形*ḱóm；该词来自晚期中古英语contraccioun、contraxion（痉挛、收缩、缩紧、压在一起的动作），再源于古法语contraction……

reviews.en: Derived from Latin contrādictus (“contradicted”), the past participle of contrādīcō (“speak against”) (originally two words).
reviews.zh: 源自拉丁语contrādictus（受到反驳的），即contrādīcō（出言反对）的过去分词；原来由两个词组成。

reviews.en: From Middle English contradiccioun, contradiction, from Old French contradiction, from Latin contrādictiō, from contrādīcō (“speak against”).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语contradiccioun、contradiction，经古法语contradiction追溯至拉丁语contrādictiō和contrādīcō（出言反对）。

reviews.en: From Middle English corrupten, derived from Latin corruptus, past participle of corrumpō (“to destroy, ruin, injure, spoil, corrupt, bribe”), from com- (“together”) +
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语corrupten，源于拉丁语corruptus，即corrumpō（毁坏、伤害、损坏、腐化、贿赂）的过去分词，其中含有com-（一起）……

reviews.en: Borrowed from French corruption, from Latin corruptiō, equivalent to corrupt + -ion.
reviews.zh: 借自法语corruption，源于拉丁语corruptiō；相当于corrupt + -ion。

reviews.en: From Medieval Latin crēdentiālis (“giving authority”), from Latin crēdentia (“trust”).
reviews.zh: 来自中世纪拉丁语crēdentiālis（给予权威的），再源于拉丁语crēdentia（信任）。

reviews.en: Borrowed from French crédibilité, from Medieval Latin credibilitas, from Latin credibilis. By surface analysis, credible + -ity.
reviews.zh: 借自法语crédibilité，经中世纪拉丁语credibilitas追溯至拉丁语credibilis；按词形可分析为credible + -ity。

reviews.en: From Middle English credible, borrowed from Middle French credible, from Latin crēdibilis (“worthy of belief”), from crēdō (“believe”); see credit.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语credible，借自中古法语credible，再源于拉丁语crēdibilis（值得相信的）和crēdō（相信）；另见credit。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French crédit (“belief, trust”), from Latin crēditum (“a loan, credit”), neuter of crēditus, past participle of crēdere (“to believe”). The
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语crédit（相信、信任），源于拉丁语crēditum（贷款、信用），这是crēditus的中性形式；crēditus是crēdere（相信）的过去分词……

reviews.en: From Middle English creditour, from Anglo-Norman creditour, from Latin crēditor, from crēditum (“loan”), from crēditus, perfect passive participle of crēdō (“lend”).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语creditour，经盎格鲁—诺曼语creditour追溯至拉丁语crēditor、crēditum（贷款）和crēditus，即crēdō（借出）的完成被动分词。

reviews.en: Originated in 1576, borrowed from Latin crēdulus (“that easily believes a thing, credulous”), from crēdō (“I believe”).
reviews.zh: 原文记载该词始见于1576年，借自拉丁语crēdulus（容易相信的、轻信的），其基础为crēdō（我相信）。

reviews.en: Inherited from Middle English crede, from Old English crēda, borrowed from Latin crēdō (“to believe”), from Proto-Italic *kresdō, from Proto-Indo-European *ḱréddʰeh₁ti (“to believe,
reviews.zh: 继承自中古英语crede，前身为古英语crēda，借自拉丁语crēdō（相信），并继续追溯到原始意大利语*kresdō和原始印欧语*ḱréddʰeh₁ti（相信）……

reviews.en: From Middle English cicle (“fixed length period of years”), from Late Latin cyclus, from Ancient Greek κύκλος (kúklos, “circle”), from Proto-Hellenic *kúklos, *kʷókʷlos,
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语cicle（固定年数的周期），经晚期拉丁语cyclus追溯至古希腊语kúklos（圆），并列出原始希腊语*kúklos、*kʷókʷlos等形式……

reviews.en: From French cyclique or its etymon Classical Latin cyclicus, from Ancient Greek κυκλικός (kuklikós). By surface analysis, cycle + -ic. Piecewise doublet of
reviews.zh: 来自法语cyclique或其词源形式古典拉丁语cyclicus，再源于古希腊语kuklikós；按词形可分析为cycle + -ic……

reviews.en: From cycle + -ist, 1882.
reviews.zh: 由cycle与-ist构成；原文记载年代为1882年。

reviews.en: From Late Middle English deducen (“to demonstrate, prove, show; to argue, infer; to bring, lead; to turn (something) to a use; to deduct”),
reviews.zh: 来自晚期中古英语deducen，具有证明、展示、论证、推断、引导、转作某种用途及扣除等意义……

reviews.en: From Middle French déduction, from Latin deductio. Equivalent to deduct + -ion or deduce + -tion.
reviews.zh: 来自中古法语déduction，再源于拉丁语deductio；相当于deduct + -ion或deduce + -tion。

reviews.en: From Latin deflecto, from de- (“away”) + flecto (“to bend”).
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语deflecto，由de-（离开）与flecto（弯曲）构成。

reviews.en: From Latin dēflexiō, from dēflectere (“to deflect”; participle stem dēflex-) + -iō (suffix forming abstract nouns). The non-etymological spelling deflection is taken from
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语dēflexiō，由dēflectere（使偏转，其分词词干为dēflex-）与构成抽象名词的后缀-iō组成；原文随后解释deflection这一拼写……

reviews.en: From Middle English deforme (“out of shape, deformed”) [and other forms], from Middle French deforme (modern French difforme (“misshapen, deformed”)), or directly from
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语deforme（变形的、不成形的）等形式，可能经中古法语deforme传入，现代法语对应difforme，也可能直接来自更早的来源……

reviews.en: Borrowed from French déporter. With the meaning of "behave", from Old French deporter (“behave”), from Latin deportō, from de- + portō.
reviews.zh: 借自法语déporter；其“举止、行为”义来自古法语deporter（举止），再源于拉丁语deportō，由de- + portō构成。

reviews.en: From Middle English descriven, from Old French descrivre, from Latin dēscrībō (“to copy off, transcribe, sketch off, describe in painting or writing”), from
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语descriven，经古法语descrivre追溯至拉丁语dēscrībō，含抄写、转写、勾画以及用绘画或文字描写等意义……

reviews.en: From Middle English descripcioun, from Old French description and its etymon, Latin dēscrīptiō, noun of action of dēscrībō (“to describe”). Equivalent to describe
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语descripcioun，经古法语description及其拉丁语源dēscrīptiō；后者是动词dēscrībō（描写）的动作名词，与describe的构词相关……

reviews.en: From Latin dēscriptīvus (“containing a full description”).
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语dēscriptīvus，意为“包含完整描述的”。

reviews.en: From Old French diametre (French diamètre), from Latin diametros, from Ancient Greek διάμετρος (diámetros) (γραμμή (grammḗ)) (diametros grammē, “line measuring across”), from διά
reviews.zh: 来自古法语diametre（现代法语diamètre），经拉丁语diametros追溯至古希腊语diámetros grammḗ，意为“横向测量的线”，其中包含diá……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin dictātor (“a chief magistrate”), from dictō (“dictate, prescribe”), from dīcō (“say, speak”). By surface analysis, dictate + -or, literally “one
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语dictātor（最高行政长官），源于dictō（口授、规定）及dīcō（说）；按词形可分析为dictate + -or……

reviews.en: From late Middle English diccion (“something said; a word or phrase”) (an obsolete sense in Modern English), borrowed directly from Latin dictiō (“a
reviews.zh: 来自晚期中古英语diccion（说出的东西、词或短语），这一用法在现代英语中已过时；它直接借自拉丁语dictiō……

reviews.en: From Middle English dixionare, a learned borrowing from Medieval Latin dictiōnārium, from Latin dictiōnārius, from dictiō (“a speaking”), from dictus, perfect past participle
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语dixionare，这是对中世纪拉丁语dictiōnārium的书面借用；再经拉丁语dictiōnārius追溯至dictiō（说话）和过去分词dictus……

reviews.en: From dis- + credit.
reviews.zh: 由dis-与credit构成。

reviews.en: From dis- + locate.
reviews.zh: 由dis-与locate构成。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin disruptus, from disrumpo, commonly dirumpo (“to break or burst asunder”), from dis-, di- (“apart, asunder”) + rumpo (“to break”).
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语disruptus，源于disrumpo，通常作dirumpo（打碎、迸裂），由dis-或di-（分开）与rumpo（打破）构成。

reviews.en: From Latin disruptionem, from disrumpere. By surface analysis, disrupt + -ion.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语disruptionem，源于disrumpere；按词形可分析为disrupt + -ion。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin distractus, from distrahō (“to pull apart”), from dis- + trahō (“to pull”).
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语distractus，源于distrahō（拉开），由dis-与trahō（拉）构成。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French distraction, from Latin distractio. Equivalent to distract + -ion.
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语distraction，源于拉丁语distractio；相当于distract + -ion。

reviews.en: From Middle French éjecter, from Latin ēiectus, perfect passive participle of ēiciō (“to throw out”), or from ēiectō, the frequentative form of the
reviews.zh: 来自中古法语éjecter，源于拉丁语ēiectus，即ēiciō（扔出）的完成被动分词，或源于其反复动作形式ēiectō……

reviews.en: First attested in 1607. From Middle French émission, from Latin ēmissiō (“sending forth”), from ēmittō (“send out”), from ex (“from, out of”) +
reviews.zh: 原文记载该词最早见于1607年；来自中古法语émission，经拉丁语ēmissiō（送出）追溯至ēmittō（发出），其中包含ex（从、向外）……

reviews.en: From Latin eruptus, past participle of ērumpō (“to break out (of), to burst out (from)”), from e (“out”) + rumpō (“to break”).
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语eruptus，即ērumpō（迸发、爆发）的过去分词，由e（向外）与rumpō（打破）构成。

reviews.en: From Middle French éruption, from Latin eruptio.
reviews.zh: 来自中古法语éruption，再源于拉丁语eruptio。

reviews.en: From Middle English evidence, from Old French [Term?], from Latin evidentia (“clearness, in Late Latin a proof”), from evidens (“clear, evident”); see evident.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语evidence；原文未列明古法语阶段的词形。其拉丁语源为evidentia（清晰；晚期拉丁语中也指证据），源于evidens（清楚的、明显的）；另见evident。

reviews.en: From Latin ēvocātīvus (“pertaining to summoning”). By surface analysis, evoke + -ative.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语ēvocātīvus（与召唤有关的）；按词形可分析为evoke + -ative。

reviews.en: From Middle English exces (“excess, ecstasy”), from Old French exces, from Latin excessus (“a going out, loss of self-possession”), from excedere, excessum (“to
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语exces（过量、狂喜），经古法语exces追溯至拉丁语excessus（走出去、失去自持）及excedere、excessum等形式……

reviews.en: From Middle English excessive, excessif, from Old French excessif, from Medieval Latin excessivus, equivalent to excess + -ive.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语excessive、excessif，经古法语excessif追溯至中世纪拉丁语excessivus；相当于excess + -ive。

reviews.en: From Latin exportare.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语exportare。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin extractum, neuter perfect passive participle of extrahō, from ex- (“out of”) + trahō (“to drag”).
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语extractum，即extrahō的中性完成被动分词，由ex-（向外）与trahō（拉）构成。

reviews.en: From Old French estraction, from Medieval Latin extractio.
reviews.zh: 来自古法语estraction，再源于中世纪拉丁语extractio。

reviews.en: From extra- + terrestrial.
reviews.zh: 由extra-与terrestrial构成。

reviews.en: From French flexibilité, from Late Latin flexibilitās, from Latin flectō (“to bend, curve”). Equivalent to flexible + -ity = flex + -ibility.
reviews.zh: 来自法语flexibilité，经晚期拉丁语flexibilitās追溯至拉丁语flectō（弯曲）；相当于flexible + -ity，也可理解为flex + -ibility。

reviews.en: From Middle French flexible, from Latin flexibilis, from flectō (“to bend, curve”). Morphologically flex + -ible.
reviews.zh: 来自中古法语flexible，经拉丁语flexibilis追溯至flectō（弯曲）；按构词可分析为flex + -ible。

reviews.en: From Middle English forme (“shape, figure, manner, bench, frame, seat, condition, agreement, etc.”), borrowed from Old French forme, from Latin fōrma (“shape, figure,
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语forme，含形状、外形、方式、长凳、框架、座位、状况和协议等意义；借自古法语forme，再源于拉丁语fōrma（形状、外形）……

reviews.en: From Middle English formel, borrowed from Old French formel, from Latin fōrmālis, from fōrma (“form”); equivalent to form + -al.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语formel，借自古法语formel，再经拉丁语fōrmālis追溯至fōrma（形式）；相当于form + -al。

reviews.en: From Middle English formacioun, formation, borrowed from Old French formacion, from Latin fōrmātiō, from fōrmō (“form”, verb); see form as verb. Morphologically form
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语formacioun、formation，借自古法语formacion，再经拉丁语fōrmātiō追溯至动词fōrmō（形成）；另见form的动词用法……

reviews.en: From Latin geōgraphicus; see French géographique. By surface analysis, geography + -ic.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语geōgraphicus；可与法语géographique比较。按词形可分析为geography + -ic。

reviews.en: From Renaissance Latin geōlogia + -ical; first attested slightly earlier than geology. By surface analysis, geo- + -logical.
reviews.zh: 来自文艺复兴时期拉丁语geōlogia与-ical；原文记载其使用略早于geology。按词形可分析为geo- + -logical。

reviews.en: From geo- + -logy, partly after Renaissance Latin geōlogia, from Ancient Greek γεω- (geō-, “earth”) + Latin -logia (“the study of”), from Ancient
reviews.zh: 由 geo- 与 -logy 构成，部分仿照文艺复兴时期拉丁语 geōlogia；其中古希腊语 geō- 意为‘地球’，拉丁语 -logia 表示‘对……的研究’，其来源还涉及古代语言……

reviews.en: From Latin geōmetricus, from Ancient Greek γεωμετρικός (geōmetrikós), from γεωμέτρης (geōmétrēs). By surface analysis, geometer + -ic or geo- + -metric.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 geōmetricus，追溯至古希腊语 geōmetrikós 和 geōmétrēs；按词形可分析为 geometer + -ic，或 geo- + -metric。

reviews.en: From Middle English gemetry, geometrie, from Old French geometrie (modern French géométrie), from Latin geōmetria, from Ancient Greek γεωμετρία (geōmetría, “geometry, land-survey”), from
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 gemetry、geometrie，经古法语 geometrie（现代法语 géométrie）追溯至拉丁语 geōmetria 和古希腊语 geōmetría（几何学、土地测量）……

reviews.en: From geo- + politics, calque of Swedish geopolitik, coined in 1900 by Rudolf Kjellén.
reviews.zh: 由 geo- 与 politics 构成，是瑞典语 geopolitik 的仿译；原文记载该瑞典语词由 Rudolf Kjellén 于1900年创造。

reviews.en: From geo- + science.
reviews.zh: 由 geo- 与 science 构成。

reviews.en: From geo- + thermal.
reviews.zh: 由 geo- 与 thermal 构成。

reviews.en: Clipping of graphic formula. From 1878; verb from 1889.
reviews.zh: 是 graphic formula 的截短形式；原文记载名词用法始于1878年，动词用法始于1889年。

reviews.en: From Latin graphicus (“belonging to painting or drawing”), from Ancient Greek γραφικός (graphikós, “belonging to painting or drawing, picturesque, of or for writing;
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 graphicus（与绘画或描绘有关的），再源于古希腊语 graphikós，表示与绘画、描绘或书写有关……

reviews.en: From French homophone; equivalent to homo- (“same”) + -phone (“sound”).
reviews.zh: 来自法语 homophone；相当于 homo-（相同）与 -phone（声音）组合。

reviews.en: From New Latin, from Ancient Greek ὑπο- (hupo-, “under”) + θέρμη (thérmē, “heat”) + -ία (-ía, “feminine suffix”) . By surface analysis, hypo-
reviews.zh: 来自新拉丁语，其组成追溯至古希腊语 hupo-（在下）、thérmē（热）及阴性后缀 -ía；原文随后开始讨论词形分析……

reviews.en: From Middle English illuminaten, borrowed from Latin illūminātus, perfect passive participle of illūminō (“lighten, light up, show off”) (see -ate (verb-forming suffix) for
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 illuminaten，借自拉丁语 illūminātus，即 illūminō（照亮、点亮、展示）的完成被动分词；原文随后提及动词后缀 -ate……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French illumination, from Late Latin illūminātiō, from Latin illumino. Equivalent to illuminate + -ion.
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语 illumination，源于晚期拉丁语 illūminātiō，再追溯至拉丁语 illumino；相当于 illuminate + -ion。

reviews.en: From Middle English importen, from Old French emporter, importer, from Latin importō (“bring in from abroad, import”, verb), from in (“in, at, on;
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 importen，经古法语 emporter、importer 追溯至拉丁语动词 importō（从国外带入、进口），其中涉及 in（在内等含义）……

reviews.en: From in- + audible.
reviews.zh: 由 in- 与 audible 构成。

reviews.en: From Middle English incredible, from Latin incrēdibilis (“that cannot be believed”), from in- (“not”) + crēdibilis (“worthy of belief”), from crēdō (“believe”), equivalent
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 incredible，源于拉丁语 incrēdibilis（无法相信的），由 in-（不）与 crēdibilis（值得相信的）组成，后者来自 crēdō（相信）……

reviews.en: From older inflexion, borrowed from Middle French inflexion, itself borrowed from Latin inflexiōnem (“alteration”, literally “bending”). The English spelling with ⟨ct⟩ is due
reviews.zh: 来自较早的拼写 inflexion，借自中古法语 inflexion，源于拉丁语 inflexiōnem（变化，字面义为弯曲）；原文随后解释英语采用 ct 拼写的原因……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French inflexible, from Latin īnflexibilis. See also in- + flexible.
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语 inflexible，源于拉丁语 īnflexibilis；也可参看 in- + flexible 的构词关系。

reviews.en: From Middle English informen, enformen, borrowed from Old French enformer, informer (“to train, instruct, inform”), from Latin īnfōrmō (“to shape, form, train, instruct,
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 informen、enformen，借自古法语 enformer、informer（训练、教导、告知），源于拉丁语 īnfōrmō（塑造、形成、训练、教导等）……

reviews.en: From Middle English enformacioun, informacioun, borrowed from Anglo-Norman informacioun, enformation, Old French information, from Latin īnfōrmātiō (“formation, conception; education”), from the participle stem
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 enformacioun、informacioun，借自盎格鲁—诺曼语 informacioun、enformation 及古法语 information，追溯至拉丁语 īnfōrmātiō（形成、概念、教育）；原文随后提及分词词干……

reviews.en: From Latin iniectus, injectus, participle of iniciō, injiciō (“to throw in”), from in- + iaciō (“I throw”).
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 iniectus、injectus，即 iniciō、injiciō（投向里面）的分词；其中包含 in- 与 iaciō（我投掷）。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French injection, from Latin iniectio. The mathematical sense is from French injection, introduced by Nicolas Bourbaki in their treatise Éléments
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语 injection，源于拉丁语 iniectio；数学义也来自法语 injection，原文提到由 Nicolas Bourbaki 在其论著中引入……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin īnscrīptiō.
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语 īnscrīptiō。

reviews.en: From Latin inspectum, past participle of inspicere (“to look into”), from in (“in”) + specere (“to look at”), equivalent to in- + -spect.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 inspectum，即 inspicere（向内看、查看）的过去分词；由 in（在内）与 specere（看）构成，相当于 in- + -spect。

reviews.en: From Middle French, from Old French inspeccion, from Latin īnspectiō (“examination, inspection”), from the verb īnspiciō (“to inspect”), from speciō (“to look at”).
reviews.zh: 经中古法语、古法语 inspeccion，追溯至拉丁语 īnspectiō（检查、检验）；后者源于 īnspiciō（检查），再与 speciō（看）相关。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin īnspector, from īnspiciō, equivalent to inspect + -or.
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语 īnspector，源于 īnspiciō；相当于 inspect + -or。

reviews.en: From Latin īnstrūctus, perfect passive participle of īnstruō (“I instruct; I arrange, furnish, or provide”).
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 īnstrūctus，即 īnstruō（我教导；我安排、装备或提供）的完成被动分词。

reviews.en: From Middle English instruccioun, from Old French instruccion, from Latin instructio; equivalent to instruct + -ion.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 instruccioun，经古法语 instruccion 追溯至拉丁语 instructio；相当于 instruct + -ion。

reviews.en: From Latin instructor, equivalent to instruct + -or.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 instructor；相当于 instruct + -or。

reviews.en: From Latin interiectus, perfect passive participle of intericiō (“place between”).
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 interiectus，即 intericiō（置于两者之间）的完成被动分词。

reviews.en: From Middle English interrupten, derived from Latin interruptus, past participle of interrumpere (“to break apart/off, interrupt”), from inter (“between”) + rumpere (“to break”).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 interrupten，源于拉丁语 interruptus，即 interrumpere（打断、使断开、中断）的过去分词；其中 inter 表示‘之间’，rumpere 表示‘打破’。

reviews.en: From Middle English interrupcioun, from Old French interrupcion, from Latin interruptio.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 interrupcioun，经古法语 interrupcion 追溯至拉丁语 interruptio。

reviews.en: From Middle English introducen, from Old French introduire, from Latin intrōdūcō, ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *h₁énteros (“inner, what is inside”) and *dewk-.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 introducen，经古法语 introduire 追溯至拉丁语 intrōdūcō；最终还涉及原始印欧语 *h₁énteros（内部、里面的东西）与 *dewk-。

reviews.en: From Middle English introduccioun, introduccyon, borrowed from Old French introduction, itself a borrowing from Latin intrōdūctiōnem, accusative of Latin intrōdūctiō, from intrōdūcō. By
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 introduccioun、introduccyon，借自古法语 introduction，源于拉丁语 intrōdūctiōnem，即 intrōdūctiō 的宾格，后者来自 intrōdūcō……

reviews.en: From Middle English invisible, from Old French invisible, from Late Latin invīsibilis. Displaced native Old English unġesewenlīċ. Morphologically in- + visible. Piecewise doublet
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 invisible，经古法语 invisible 追溯至晚期拉丁语 invīsibilis，取代了本土古英语 unġesewenlīċ；词形可分析为 in- + visible……

reviews.en: From Middle English *invoken, envoken, borrowed from Old French envoquer, from Latin invocāre (“to call upon”), itself from in- + vocare (“to call”).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 *invoken、envoken，借自古法语 envoquer，源于拉丁语 invocāre（呼求）；由 in- 与 vocare（呼叫）组成。

reviews.en: From kilo- + meter.
reviews.zh: 由 kilo- 与 meter 构成。

reviews.en: From Middle English local, from Late Latin locālis (“belonging to a place”), possibly also via Old French local; ultimately from Latin locus (“a
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 local，源于晚期拉丁语 locālis（属于某个地方的），也可能经过古法语 local；最终追溯至拉丁语 locus……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin locātus, perfect passive participle of locō (“to place”) (see -ate (verb-forming suffix)), from locus (“place”) + -ō (verb-forming suffix). Cognate
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语 locātus，即 locō（放置）的完成被动分词；locō 由 locus（地方）和动词构成后缀 -ō 组成，另可参看 -ate……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin locatio, locationis (“a placing”), from locare (“to place, put, set, let”), from locus (“a place”). Equivalent to locate + -ion.
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语 locatio、locationis（放置），源于 locare（放、置、设置、出租），后者来自 locus（地方）；相当于 locate + -ion。

reviews.en: From Late Middle English lūminārī, lūminārīe (“lamp; source of spiritual light, example of holiness; glory”), borrowed from Old French luminarie (“lamp, lights, lighting;
reviews.zh: 来自晚期中古英语 lūminārī、lūminārīe（灯；精神上的光源、圣洁的榜样；荣耀），借自古法语 luminarie（灯、灯光、照明等）……

reviews.en: From stem of Latin lumen (“light”) + -escent, equivalent to luminesce + -ent.
reviews.zh: 由拉丁语 lumen（光）的词干与 -escent 构成；相当于 luminesce + -ent。

reviews.en: Borrowed from French luminosité or else a native formation from luminous + -ity.
reviews.zh: 可能借自法语 luminosité，也可能是在英语中由 luminous + -ity 构成。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French lumineus, from Latin lūminōsus.
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语 lumineus，源于拉丁语 lūminōsus。

reviews.en: From French manucure.
reviews.zh: 来自法语 manucure。

reviews.en: Back-formation from manipulation.
reviews.zh: 由 manipulation 逆构形成。

reviews.en: From Middle English manuel, from Anglo-Norman manuel, Old French manual, from Latin manuālis, from manus (“hand”).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 manuel，经盎格鲁—诺曼语 manuel、古法语 manual 追溯至拉丁语 manuālis，后者源于 manus（手）。

reviews.en: From Middle French manufacture, from Old French, from Medieval Latin manūfactūra (“a making by hand”), from manūfactus, a compound of manū factus, manū
reviews.zh: 经中古法语 manufacture、古法语追溯至中世纪拉丁语 manūfactūra（手工制作），源于 manūfactus；该词由 manū factus 组合而成……

reviews.en: From manufacture + -er.
reviews.zh: 由 manufacture 与 -er 构成。

reviews.en: From Medieval Latin manūscrīptum (“writing by hand”), a calque of Germanic origin: compare Middle Low German hantschrift (“manuscript, document”), Middle Dutch hantscrift (“manuscript”)
reviews.zh: 来自中世纪拉丁语 manūscrīptum（用手书写），是对日耳曼语词的仿译；可比较中古低地德语 hantschrift（手稿、文件）和中古荷兰语 hantscrift（手稿）。

reviews.en: From Latin mediterrāneus (“inland”, from medius (“middle”) + terra (“earth, land”) + -āneus (adjectival suffix)) + -an.
reviews.zh: 由拉丁语 mediterrāneus（内陆的）与 -an 构成；mediterrāneus 由 medius（中间）、terra（土地）及形容词后缀 -āneus 组成。

reviews.en: From mega- + -phone.
reviews.zh: 由 mega- 与 -phone 构成。

reviews.en: From Middle English meter, metre, from Old English meter and Old French metre; both from Latin metrum, from Ancient Greek μέτρον (métron).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 meter、metre，其前身为古英语 meter 和古法语 metre；两者均源于拉丁语 metrum，最终追溯至古希腊语 métron。

reviews.en: From French métrique (1864), from New Latin metricus (“pertaining to the system based on the meter”), from metrum (“a meter”); see meter. By
reviews.zh: 来自法语 métrique（原文注明1864年），源于新拉丁语 metricus（与以米为基础的体系有关的），后者来自 metrum（米）；另见 meter……

reviews.en: From Ancient Greek μέτρον (métron, “measure”) + English -logy.
reviews.zh: 由古希腊语 métron（度量）与英语 -logy 构成。

reviews.en: From micro- + biology.
reviews.zh: 由 micro- 与 biology 构成。

reviews.en: From micro- + chip.
reviews.zh: 由 micro- 与 chip 构成。

reviews.en: From French microcosme, from Latin microcosmus, from Ancient Greek μικρός (mikrós, “small”) + κόσμος (kósmos, “universe, order”), equivalent to micro- + -cosm.
reviews.zh: 来自法语 microcosme，经拉丁语 microcosmus 追溯至古希腊语 mikrós（小）与 kósmos（宇宙、秩序）；相当于 micro- + -cosm。

reviews.en: From micro- + economics.
reviews.zh: 由 micro- 与 economics 构成。

reviews.en: From micro- + organism.
reviews.zh: 由 micro- 与 organism 构成。

reviews.en: From micro- + -phone.
reviews.zh: 由 micro- 与 -phone 构成。

reviews.en: From micro- + plastic.
reviews.zh: 由 micro- 与 plastic 构成。

reviews.en: From New Latin microscopium and Italian microscopio, from Ancient Greek μικρός (mikrós, “small”) + σκοπέω (skopéō, “to look at”), equivalent to micro- +
reviews.zh: 来自新拉丁语 microscopium 和意大利语 microscopio，追溯至古希腊语 mikrós（小）与 skopéō（看）；原文随后开始说明对应的构词形式……

reviews.en: From microscope + -ic.
reviews.zh: 由 microscope 与 -ic 构成。

reviews.en: From micro- + wave.
reviews.zh: 由 micro- 与 wave 构成。

reviews.en: From motor + cycle, from the Motorcyclette produced in 1897 by the French Werner Frères et Cie.
reviews.zh: 由 motor 与 cycle 构成；原文将其与法国 Werner Frères et Cie 公司于1897年生产的 Motorcyclette 联系起来。

reviews.en: From multiculture + -al or multi- + cultural.
reviews.zh: 由 multiculture + -al，或 multi- + cultural 构成。

reviews.en: From multi- + facet + -ed.
reviews.zh: 由 multi-、facet 与 -ed 构成。

reviews.en: From multi- + lingual.
reviews.zh: 由 multi- 与 lingual 构成。

reviews.en: From multi- + media.
reviews.zh: 由 multi- 与 media 构成。

reviews.en: From multi- + national.
reviews.zh: 由 multi- 与 national 构成。

reviews.en: From French multiple, itself from Late Latin multiplus.
reviews.zh: 来自法语 multiple，后者源于晚期拉丁语 multiplus。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French, from Old French multiplicacion, from Latin multiplicatio, multiplicationem; ~equivalent to multiplicate + -ion.
reviews.zh: 经中古法语和古法语 multiplicacion 借入，追溯至拉丁语 multiplicatio、multiplicationem；大致相当于 multiplicate + -ion。

reviews.en: From Old French multiplier, from Latin multiplicō, from multi (“many”) + plicō (“to fold”). The noun presumably derives from the verb.
reviews.zh: 来自古法语 multiplier，源于拉丁语 multiplicō，由 multi（多）与 plicō（折叠）构成；名词用法可能由动词派生。

reviews.en: From Old French object, from Medieval Latin obiectum (“object”, literally “thrown against”), from obiectus, perfect passive participle of obiciō (“to throw against”), from
reviews.zh: 来自古法语 object，源于中世纪拉丁语 obiectum（对象，字面义为投向对面），后者来自 obiectus，即 obiciō（投向、抛向）的完成被动分词……

reviews.en: From Middle French objection, from Old French objeccion, from Latin obiectio. Equivalent to object + -ion.
reviews.zh: 来自中古法语 objection，经古法语 objeccion 追溯至拉丁语 obiectio；相当于 object + -ion。

reviews.en: From Latin past participle stem obstruct- (“blocked up”), from verb obstruere, from ob (“against”) + struere (“pile up, build”).
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语过去分词词干 obstruct-（被堵住的），源于动词 obstruere，由 ob（对着）与 struere（堆积、建造）构成。

reviews.en: From Latin obstructio (“hindrance”), from obstruo (“build against, block, stop”).
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 obstructio（妨碍），源于 obstruo（挡着建造、阻挡、停止）。

reviews.en: From Middle English paragraf, from Middle French paragraphe from Latin paragraphus (“sign for start of a new section of discourse”), from Ancient Greek
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 paragraf，经中古法语 paragraphe 追溯至拉丁语 paragraphus（表示新段落开始的符号），其更早来源涉及古希腊语……

reviews.en: From Latin perimetros, Ancient Greek περίμετρος (perímetros). Equivalent to peri- + meter.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 perimetros 和古希腊语 perímetros；相当于 peri- + meter。

reviews.en: From Middle English permision, permission, permissioun, permyssion, from Middle French permission, from Latin permissiō. Equivalent to permit + -ion. Mostly replaced native English
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 permision、permission、permissioun、permyssion，经中古法语 permission 追溯至拉丁语 permissiō；相当于 permit + -ion，原文随后提到它取代的英语本土词……

reviews.en: From Middle English permitten, borrowed from Middle French permettre, from Latin permittō (“give up, allow”), from per (“through”) + mittō (“send”).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 permitten，借自中古法语 permettre，源于拉丁语 permittō（放弃、允许）；其中 per 表示‘穿过’，mittō 表示‘发送’。

reviews.en: From Middle English perspective, perspectif, attested since 1381, from Old French or Middle French, from the first word of the Medieval Latin perspectiva
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 perspective、perspectif，原文记载自1381年已有使用；借自古法语或中古法语，后者源于中世纪拉丁语某表达的第一个词 perspectiva……

reviews.en: Learned borrowing from Ancient Greek φωνή (phōnḗ, “sound”).
reviews.zh: 这一词源分支是从古希腊语 phōnḗ（声音）借入的学术借词。

reviews.en: From Ancient Greek φώνημα (phṓnēma, “sound”), from φωνέω (phōnéō, “to sound”), from φωνή (phōnḗ, “sound”). By surface analysis, phone (“speech sound”) + -eme
reviews.zh: 来自古希腊语 phṓnēma（声音），源于 phōnéō（发声），后者来自 phōnḗ（声音）；按词形可分析为 phone（语音）与 -eme。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin phōnēticus, from Ancient Greek φωνητῐκός (phōnētĭkós). By surface analysis, phone + -etic.
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语 phōnēticus，源于古希腊语 phōnētĭkós；按词形可分析为 phone + -etic。

reviews.en: From phono- (prefix denoting sound) + -logy (suffix denoting a branch of learning, or a study of a particular subject).
reviews.zh: 由 phono-（表示声音的前缀）与 -logy（表示学科或对某主题研究的后缀）构成。

reviews.en: From photo- + copy.
reviews.zh: 由 photo- 与 copy 构成。

reviews.en: From photo- + -genic.
reviews.zh: 由 photo- 与 -genic 构成。

reviews.en: From photo- + -graph.
reviews.zh: 由 photo- 与 -graph 构成。

reviews.en: From photograph + -er, from Ancient Greek φωτός (phōtós), genitive singular of φῶς (phôs, “light”) (fōs) and γράφω (gráphō, “I write”). By surface
reviews.zh: 由 photograph 与 -er 构成；其来源涉及古希腊语 phōtós，即 phôs（光）的单数属格，以及 gráphō（我书写）……

reviews.en: From photo- + -graphic or photograph + -ic.
reviews.zh: 由 photo- + -graphic，或 photograph + -ic 构成。

reviews.en: From French photographie. By surface analysis, photo- + -graphy, together meaning "drawing with light" or "representation by means of lines", "drawing". From φῶς
reviews.zh: 来自法语 photographie；按词形可分析为 photo- + -graphy，合起来有‘用光描绘’的意思；原文同时解释相关的‘以线条表现、绘画’含义，并提及希腊语 φῶς……

reviews.en: From photo- + -on. Coined by American physicist Leonard Troland in 1916 as a unit of light hitting the retina, and later popularized
reviews.zh: 由 photo- 与 -on 构成；原文记载美国物理学家 Leonard Troland 于1916年创造此词，用作照射到视网膜上的光的单位，后来得到推广……

reviews.en: From photo- + receptor.
reviews.zh: 由 photo- 与 receptor 构成。

reviews.en: From photo- + synthesis.
reviews.zh: 由 photo- 与 synthesis 构成。

reviews.en: From Middle English portable, from Middle French portable and Latin portābilis. By surface analysis, port (“to carry”) + -able.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 portable，其前身为中古法语 portable 与拉丁语 portābilis；按词形可分析为 port（携带）+ -able。

reviews.en: From Middle French précéder, from Latin praecēdō, from prae- + cēdō.
reviews.zh: 来自中古法语 précéder，源于拉丁语 praecēdō，由 prae- 与 cēdō 构成。

reviews.en: From Middle French, from Old French, from Latin praecēdēns, present participle of praecēdere (“to precede”); See precede.
reviews.zh: 经中古法语和古法语传入，源于拉丁语 praecēdēns，即 praecēdere（先于）的现在分词；另见 precede。

reviews.en: Early 17th century, from Latin praedicō (“to mention beforehand”) (perfect passive participle praedictus), from prae- (“before”) + dīcō (“to say”). Equivalent to Germanic
reviews.zh: 原文记载该词出现于17世纪初，来自拉丁语 praedicō（预先提及，完成被动分词为 praedictus），由 prae-（在前）与 dīcō（说）组成……

reviews.en: From predict + -able.
reviews.zh: 由 predict 与 -able 构成。

reviews.en: Learned borrowing from Latin praedictiō, praedictiōnis; equivalent to predict + -ion. Compare the Germanic equivalents forespeaking, foretale, foretelling.
reviews.zh: 从拉丁语 praedictiō、praedictiōnis 借入的学术词，相当于 predict + -ion；可与日耳曼语来源的 forespeaking、foretale、foretelling 比较。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin praescrībere, from prae- (“before, in front”) and scrībere (“to write”).
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语 praescrībere，由 prae-（之前、前面）与 scrībere（书写）构成。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French, from Old French prescripcion, from Latin praescriptio (“preface; pretext; something written ahead of time”), from prae- (“pre-, before”) +
reviews.zh: 经中古法语、古法语 prescripcion 借入，源于拉丁语 praescriptio（序言、借口、预先写好的东西）；其组成包含 prae-（在前）……

reviews.en: From Middle English proceden, from Old French proceder, from Latin prōcēdō (“to go forth, go forward, advance”), from prō (“forth”) + cēdō (“to
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 proceden，经古法语 proceder 追溯至拉丁语 prōcēdō（出发、向前走、前进），其中包含 prō（向前）和 cēdō……

reviews.en: From Middle English proces, from Old French procés (“journey”), from Latin prōcessus (“course, progression”), nominalization of prōcēdō (“proceed, advance”).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 proces，经古法语 procés（旅程）追溯至拉丁语 prōcessus（过程、进展），它是 prōcēdō（继续、前进）的名词化形式。

reviews.en: From Middle English processioun, borrowed from Old French pourciession, from Latin prōcessiō (“a marching forward, an advance, in Late Latin a religious procession”),
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 processioun，借自古法语 pourciession，源于拉丁语 prōcessiō（向前行进、推进；在晚期拉丁语中也指宗教行列）……

reviews.en: From Middle English produce, from Latin prōdūcō (“to lead forth”), from prō- (“forth, forward”) + dūcō (“to lead, bring”).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 produce，源于拉丁语 prōdūcō（领向前方），由 prō-（向前）与 dūcō（引导、带来）构成。

reviews.en: From Middle English product, from Latin prōductus, perfect participle of prōdūcō, first attested in English in the mathematics sense.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 product，源于拉丁语 prōductus，即 prōdūcō 的完成分词；英语最早的使用记录属于数学义项。

reviews.en: From Middle English produccioun, from Old French production, from Latin prōductiō, prōductiōnem (“a lengthening, prolonging”). Equivalent to produce + -tion. See produce.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 produccioun，经古法语 production 追溯至拉丁语 prōductiō、prōductiōnem（拉长、延长）；相当于 produce + -tion，另见 produce。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Late Latin productivus, equivalent to product + -ive.
reviews.zh: 借自晚期拉丁语 productivus；相当于 product + -ive。

reviews.en: From Latin prōiectus, perfect passive participle of prōiciō (“throw forth, extend; expel”). Compare typologically Russian прики́дывать (prikídyvatʹ), прики́дка (prikídka) (akin to кида́ть (kidátʹ));
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 prōiectus，即 prōiciō（向前抛、伸出、逐出）的完成被动分词；原文还作了语言类型上的比较，提及俄语 prikídyvatʹ、prikídka 及相关动词 kidátʹ……

reviews.en: From either the Middle French projection or its etymon, the Classical Latin prōiectiō (stem: prōiectiōn-), from prōiciō, equivalent to project + -ion. Compare
reviews.zh: 可能来自中古法语 projection，也可能直接来自其古典拉丁语词源 prōiectiō（词干 prōiectiōn-），源于 prōiciō；相当于 project + -ion……

reviews.en: From Middle English prospecte, from Latin prōspectus (“view, sight, prospect; panorama”), from prōspiciō (“to look forward”) + -tus (suffix forming action nouns), from
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 prospecte，源于拉丁语 prōspectus（景色、视野、前景、全景）；后者由 prōspiciō（向前看）与构成动作名词的后缀 -tus 相关形式构成……

reviews.en: From Middle French prospectif, from Late Latin prospectivus. See more at English prospect.
reviews.zh: 来自中古法语 prospectif，源于晚期拉丁语 prospectivus；更多资料参见英语 prospect。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French provoquer, from Old French, from Latin prōvocāre. Doublet of provocate.
reviews.zh: 经中古法语 provoquer 和古法语借入，源于拉丁语 prōvocāre；与 provocate 是同源异形词。

reviews.en: From psychiatry + -ist.
reviews.zh: 由 psychiatry 与 -ist 构成。

reviews.en: Borrowed from French psychiatrie. First attested in 1846.
reviews.zh: 借自法语 psychiatrie；原文记载首次使用见于1846年。

reviews.en: From Ancient Greek ψυχικός (psukhikós, “relative to the soul, spirit, mind”). Earlier referred to as "psychical"; or from Ancient Greek ψυχή (psukhḗ, “soul,
reviews.zh: 来自古希腊语 psukhikós（与灵魂、精神、心智有关的），较早形式为 psychical；原文另提到由古希腊语 psukhḗ 派生的路径……

reviews.en: From psychology + -ical.
reviews.zh: 由 psychology 与 -ical 构成。

reviews.en: From psycholog(y) + -ist.
reviews.zh: 由 psycholog(y) 与 -ist 构成。

reviews.en: From French psychologie, from Renaissance Latin psychologia, from Ancient Greek ψυχή (psukhḗ, “soul”) + -λογία (-logía, “study of”), equivalent to psycho- + -logy.
reviews.zh: 来自法语 psychologie，经文艺复兴时期拉丁语 psychologia 追溯至古希腊语 psukhḗ（灵魂）与 -logía（对……的研究）；相当于 psycho- + -logy。

reviews.en: From psycho- + somatic.
reviews.zh: 由 psycho- 与 somatic 构成。

reviews.en: From psycho- + therapy.
reviews.zh: 由 psycho- 与 therapy 构成。

reviews.en: Inherited from Middle English receden, from Middle French receder and its etymon Latin recedere (“to withdraw; to go back”), from re- + cedere
reviews.zh: 沿用中古英语 receden，前身为中古法语 receder 及其拉丁语词源 recedere（撤退、往回走），由 re- 与 cedere 构成……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin recessiō, from recēdō (“recede, retreat”), from re- (“back”) + cēdō (“to go”). By surface analysis, recess + -ion.
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语 recessiō，源于 recēdō（后退、撤退），由 re-（向后）与 cēdō（行进）组成；按词形可分析为 recess + -ion。

reviews.en: From re- + construct.
reviews.zh: 由 re- 与 construct 构成。

reviews.en: From recycle + -able.
reviews.zh: 由 recycle 与 -able 构成。

reviews.en: From re- + cycle.
reviews.zh: 由 re- 与 cycle 构成。

reviews.en: From Middle English reducen, from Old French reduire, from Latin redūcō (“reduce”); from re- (“back”) + dūcō (“lead”). See duke, and compare with
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 reducen，经古法语 reduire 追溯至拉丁语 redūcō（减少），由 re-（向后）与 dūcō（引导）组成；原文另提及 duke 等词……

reviews.en: From Middle English reduccion, a borrowing from Old French reducion, from Latin reductiō, reductiōnem. Equivalent to reduce + -tion.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 reduccion，借自古法语 reducion，源于拉丁语 reductiō、reductiōnem；相当于 reduce + -tion。

reviews.en: From Old French reflecter (“to bend back, turn back”), from Latin reflectō (“to reflect”), from re- (“again”) + flectō (“to bend, to curve”).
reviews.zh: 来自古法语 reflecter（向后弯、转回），源于拉丁语 reflectō（反射），由 re-（再次）与 flectō（弯、使弯曲）组成。

reviews.en: From Middle English refleccion, refleccioun, refleccioune, reflection, from Middle French reflection, reflexion, and its source Late Latin reflexiō, from the participle stem of
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 refleccion、refleccioun、refleccioune、reflection，前身为中古法语 reflection、reflexion 及其晚期拉丁语词源 reflexiō；原文随后提及分词词干……

reviews.en: From Late Latin reflexus, past participle of reflectere (“to bend back”), equivalent to re- + flex. Photography sense is from noun sense meaning
reviews.zh: 来自晚期拉丁语 reflexus，即 reflectere（向后弯）的过去分词；相当于 re- + flex。原文随后解释摄影义与某个名词义的联系……

reviews.en: From Middle English reformen, from Old French reformer, from Latin reformo, reformare. As a noun since 1660s, from French réforme.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 reformen，经古法语 reformer 追溯至拉丁语 reformo、reformare；名词用法自17世纪60年代起出现，源于法语 réforme。

reviews.en: From Late Middle English rejecten, from Latin reiectus, past participle of reicere (“to throw back”), from re- (“back”) + iacere (“to throw”). Displaced
reviews.zh: 来自晚期中古英语 rejecten，源于拉丁语 reiectus，即 reicere（扔回）的过去分词；由 re-（向后）与 iacere（投掷）构成……

reviews.en: From French réjection or directly from Latin reiectiōnem, accusative of Latin reiectiō. Displaced native Old English āworpennes (literally “thrown-out-ness”).
reviews.zh: 可能来自法语 réjection，也可能直接来自拉丁语 reiectiōnem，即 reiectiō 的宾格；它取代了本土古英语 āworpennes，后者字面意思是‘被扔出去的状态’。

reviews.en: From re- + locate.
reviews.zh: 由 re- 与 locate 构成。

reviews.en: From re- + location.
reviews.zh: 由 re- 与 location 构成。

reviews.en: From Middle English reporten, from Anglo-Norman reporter, from Latin reportāre (“to carry back, return, remit, refer”), from re- + portāre.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 reporten，经盎格鲁—诺曼语 reporter 追溯至拉丁语 reportāre（带回、返回、交还、提及），由 re- 与 portāre 构成。

reviews.en: From Middle English reportour, from Old French reporteur; equivalent to report + -er.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 reportour，源于古法语 reporteur；相当于 report + -er。

reviews.en: From respect + -ful.
reviews.zh: 由 respect 与 -ful 构成。

reviews.en: From Late Middle English retracten, retract (“to absorb, draw in”), from Latin retractus (“withdrawn”), the perfect passive participle of Latin retrahō (“to draw
reviews.zh: 来自晚期中古英语 retracten、retract（吸收、吸入），源于拉丁语 retractus（被收回的），即 retrahō 的完成被动分词；原文的动词释义在此截断……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin retrōspectum, from retrōspicio (“to look back at”), equivalent to retro- + -spect. Compare review.
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语 retrōspectum，源于 retrōspicio（回头看）；相当于 retro- + -spect，可与 review 比较。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French réviser, from Latin revīsō, from re- + vīsō (“examine”), frequentative of videō (“see”).
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语 réviser，源于拉丁语 revīsō，由 re- 与 vīsō（查看）构成；vīsō 是 videō（看）的反复体形式。

reviews.en: From re- + vision.
reviews.zh: 由 re- 与 vision 构成。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French révoquer, from Latin revocare, from re- + voco, vocare. Doublet of revocate.
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语 révoquer，源于拉丁语 revocare，由 re- 与 voco、vocare 组成；与 revocate 是同源异形词。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French rupture, or its source, Latin ruptūra (“a breaking, rupture (of a limb or vein)”) and Medieval Latin ruptūra (“a
reviews.zh: 可能借自中古法语 rupture，或直接来自其拉丁语词源 ruptūra（破裂，尤其肢体或静脉的破裂）；原文也提及中世纪拉丁语的相关义项……

reviews.en: From Middle English spectacle, from Middle French spectacle, from Latin spectāculum (“a show, spectacle”), from spectō (“to see, behold”), frequentative of speciō (“to
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 spectacle，经中古法语 spectacle 追溯至拉丁语 spectāculum（表演、景象），源于 spectō（看、注视），后者是 speciō 的反复体形式……

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin spectātor, from frequentative verb spectō (“watch”), from speciō (“look at”). Equivalent to spectate + -or. Doublet of speculator.
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语 spectātor，源于反复体动词 spectō（观看），再追溯至 speciō（看）；相当于 spectate + -or，与 speculator 是同源异形词。

reviews.en: From structure + -al, 19th century.
reviews.zh: 由 structure 与 -al 构成，原文注明出现于19世纪。

reviews.en: From Middle French structure, from Latin structūra (“a fitting together, adjustment, building, erection, a building, edifice, structure”), from struere, past participle structus (“pile
reviews.zh: 来自中古法语 structure，源于拉丁语 structūra（装配、调整、建造、建筑物、结构），与 struere 及其过去分词 structus 有关……

reviews.en: From sub- + aquatic.
reviews.zh: 由 sub- 与 aquatic 构成。

reviews.en: From Middle English subget, from Old French suget, from Latin subiectus (“lying under or near, adjacent, also subject, exposed”), as a noun, subiectus
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 subget，经古法语 suget 追溯至拉丁语 subiectus（位于下方或近旁、邻近的，也可表示受支配或暴露于某物）；原文随后讨论其名词形式……

reviews.en: From Latin subiectīvus, equivalent to subject + -ive.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 subiectīvus；相当于 subject + -ive。

reviews.en: From Middle English submissioun, from Old French soubmission, from Latin submissio, from submitto.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 submissioun，经古法语 soubmission 追溯至拉丁语 submissio，后者源于 submitto。

reviews.en: From Middle English submitten, borrowed from Latin submittere, infinitive of submittō (“place under, yield”), from sub (“under, from below, up”) + mitto (“to
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 submitten，借自拉丁语 submittere，即 submittō（放在下面、让步）的不定式；其中包含 sub（下面、由下向上）及 mitto……

reviews.en: From Middle English subscriben, subskryben, from Latin subscrībere (“write beneath”). By surface analysis, sub- + scribe. Compare its native English equivalent underwrite.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 subscriben、subskryben，源于拉丁语 subscrībere（写在下方）；按词形可分析为 sub- + scribe，可与英语本土对应词 underwrite 比较。

reviews.en: From Latin subscriptiō; by surface analysis, sub- + script + -ion. All senses reflect (either literally or figuratively) the notion of signing one's
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 subscriptiō；按词形可分析为 sub- + script + -ion。原文指出各义项都直接或比喻地反映了签署的概念，摘录在此截断……

reviews.en: From Latin subterrāneus + -an. Compare subterrane and subterraneous.
reviews.zh: 由拉丁语 subterrāneus 与 -an 构成；可与 subterrane、subterraneous 比较。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin subtractus, perfect passive participle of subtrahō (“to draw from beneath; withdraw, remove”); from sub (“under”) + trahō (“to draw, pull,
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语 subtractus，即 subtrahō（从下面拉走、撤回、移除）的完成被动分词；其中 sub 表示‘在下’，trahō 表示‘拉’……

reviews.en: From success + -ful.
reviews.zh: 由 success 与 -ful 构成。

reviews.en: From successful + -ly.
reviews.zh: 由 successful 与 -ly 构成。

reviews.en: From Latin succedere (“to succeed in”).
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 succedere，原文将其解释为‘在……方面成功’。

reviews.en: From Anglo-Norman successour, from Latin successor.
reviews.zh: 来自盎格鲁—诺曼语 successour，源于拉丁语 successor。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Medieval Latin supervisus, from supervidere, from Latin super + videre. Doublet of survey.
reviews.zh: 借自中世纪拉丁语 supervisus，源于 supervidere，由拉丁语 super 与 videre 组成；与 survey 是同源异形词。

reviews.en: Attested since the 15th century C.E.; from Middle English supervisor, supervisour, supervysor, supervysour, from Latin supervīsor, from supervideō, in turn from super +
reviews.zh: 原文记载该词自公元15世纪已有使用；来自中古英语 supervisor、supervisour、supervysor、supervysour，源于拉丁语 supervīsor，再追溯至 supervideō……

reviews.en: From Middle English supporten, from Old French supporter, from Latin supportō.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 supporten，经古法语 supporter 追溯至拉丁语 supportō。

reviews.en: From support + -ive.
reviews.zh: 由 support 与 -ive 构成。

reviews.en: From Old French suspect, from Latin suspectus, perfect passive participle of suspiciō (“mistrust, suspect”), from sub (“under”), + speciō (“watch, look at”).
reviews.zh: 来自古法语 suspect，源于拉丁语 suspectus，即 suspiciō（不信任、怀疑）的完成被动分词；其组成包含 sub（在下）与 speciō（观看、看）。

reviews.en: From Latin symmetria, from Ancient Greek συμμετρία (summetría), from σύμμετρος (súmmetros, “symmetrical”), from σύν (sún, “with”) + μέτρον (métron, “measure”). By surface analysis,
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 symmetria，源于古希腊语 summetría，再追溯至 súmmetros（对称的），由 sún（与……一起）与 métron（尺度）构成……

reviews.en: From Middle English symphonye, from Old French simphonie, from Latin symphonia, from Ancient Greek συμφωνία (sumphōnía). By surface analysis, sym- + -phony. Doublet
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 symphonye，经古法语 simphonie、拉丁语 symphonia 追溯至古希腊语 sumphōnía；按词形可分析为 sym- + -phony……

reviews.en: From Ancient Greek συγχρονίζω (sunkhronízō), equivalent to syn- + chrono- + -ize.
reviews.zh: 来自古希腊语 sunkhronízō；相当于 syn- + chrono- + -ize。

reviews.en: From tele- + commute.
reviews.zh: 由 tele- 与 commute 构成。

reviews.en: Borrowed from French télégraphe, equivalent to tele- (“far, distant”) + -graph (“writing”), suggested as a new name for Claude Chappe's overland semaphore network
reviews.zh: 借自法语 télégraphe，相当于 tele-（远）+ -graph（书写）；原文称这一名称曾被提议用于 Claude Chappe 的陆上旗语通信网络……

reviews.en: From tele- + -metry.
reviews.zh: 由 tele- 与 -metry 构成。

reviews.en: From tele- + -pathy.
reviews.zh: 由 tele- 与 -pathy 构成。

reviews.en: The noun is derived from tele- (prefix meaning ‘from a distance’) + -phone (suffix denoting a device which makes a sound), modelled after
reviews.zh: 这一名词由 tele-（表示‘从远处’的前缀）与 -phone（表示发声设备的后缀）构成；原文随后提及其仿造对象……

reviews.en: From tele- + -scope. From Latin tēlescopium, from Ancient Greek τηλεσκόπος (tēleskópos, “far-seeing”), from τῆλε (têle, “afar”) + σκοπέω (skopéō, “to look at”).
reviews.zh: 由 tele- 与 -scope 构成；源于拉丁语 tēlescopium，追溯至古希腊语 tēleskópos（能看远处的），由 têle（远处）与 skopéō（看）组成。

reviews.en: From tele- + vision. First attested in 1900, probably influenced by French télévision from Constantin Perskyi's 1900 paper that was unpublished but presented
reviews.zh: 由 tele- 与 vision 构成，原文记载首次出现于1900年；它可能受到法语 télévision 的影响，该法语词见于 Constantin Perskyi 在1900年宣读但未出版的论文……

reviews.en: Unadapted borrowing from French terrain, from Latin terrenum (“land, ground”), neuter of terrenus (“consisting of earth”), from terra (“earth”).
reviews.zh: 从法语 terrain 直接借入而未作形式改造；源于拉丁语 terrenum（土地、地面），即 terrenus（土质的）的中性形式，后者来自 terra（土地）。

reviews.en: From Latin terra (“earth”) + -arium, by analogy with aquarium.
reviews.zh: 由拉丁语 terra（土地）与 -arium 构成，类推自 aquarium。

reviews.en: From Middle English terrestrialle, from terrestre or Latin terrestris, from terra (“land, earth, ground”), with the suffix -al.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 terrestrialle，由 terrestre 或拉丁语 terrestris 加上 -al 构成，其来源与 terra（土地、大地、地面）有关。

reviews.en: Inherited from Middle English territorie, from Latin territōrium.
reviews.zh: 沿用中古英语 territorie，源于拉丁语 territōrium。

reviews.en: From French thermal, from New Latin *thermalis, from Ancient Greek θέρμη (thérmē, “heat”), from Proto-Indo-European *gʷʰer- (“to heat, warm”).
reviews.zh: 来自法语 thermal，经新拉丁语 *thermalis 追溯至古希腊语 thérmē（热），最终涉及原始印欧语 *gʷʰer-（加热、使温暖）。

reviews.en: From thermo- + dynamics. First attested in the 1850s.
reviews.zh: 由 thermo- 与 dynamics 构成；原文记载首次出现于19世纪50年代。

reviews.en: Borrowed from French thermomètre; equivalent to thermo- + -meter.
reviews.zh: 借自法语 thermomètre；相当于 thermo- + -meter。

reviews.en: From thermo- + -stat.
reviews.zh: 由 thermo- 与 -stat 构成。

reviews.en: From Latin transcriptum, from transcribere.
reviews.zh: 来自拉丁语 transcriptum，源于 transcribere。

reviews.en: From Middle English transformen, from Old French transformer, from Latin transformo, transformare, from trans (“across”, preposition) + forma (“form”).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 transformen，经古法语 transformer 追溯至拉丁语 transformo、transformare，由介词 trans（跨越）与 forma（形式）组成。

reviews.en: Inherited from Middle English transformacioun, from Middle French, from Ecclesiastical Latin trānsfōrmātiō. Morphologically transform + -ation.
reviews.zh: 沿用中古英语 transformacioun，经中古法语追溯至教会拉丁语 trānsfōrmātiō；形态上可分析为 transform + -ation。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Latin transmissionem (accusative of transmissio), from transmittere.
reviews.zh: 借自拉丁语 transmissionem，即 transmissio 的宾格，源于 transmittere。

reviews.en: From Middle English transmitten, borrowed from Latin trānsmittō (“transmit”, verb, literally “across-send”).
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 transmitten，借自拉丁语动词 trānsmittō（传送），其字面构词含义为‘跨越—发送’。

reviews.en: From transmit + -er.
reviews.zh: 由 transmit 与 -er 构成。

reviews.en: Inherited from Middle English transporten, a borrowing from Old French transporter (“carry or convey across”), from Latin trānsportāre (“to carry over, take across,
reviews.zh: 沿用中古英语 transporten，后者借自古法语 transporter（运过、输送过），源于拉丁语 trānsportāre（运过、带过等）……

reviews.en: From transport + -ation.
reviews.zh: 由 transport 与 -ation 构成。

reviews.en: Borrowed from Middle French uniforme, from Latin uniformis.
reviews.zh: 借自中古法语 uniforme，源于拉丁语 uniformis。

reviews.en: From Middle English verdit, from Anglo-Norman verdit (> Medieval Latin veredictum), from veir (“true”) + dit (“saying”); possibly a calque of a Germanic
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 verdit，源于盎格鲁—诺曼语 verdit，后者又产生了中世纪拉丁语 veredictum；由 veir（真实）与 dit（所说的话）组成，可能是对日耳曼语表达的仿译……

reviews.en: From the root vide of Latin videō (“to see”) + -o, formed in analogy to audio.
reviews.zh: 由拉丁语 videō（看）的词根 vide 加 -o 构成，形式上类推自 audio。

reviews.en: From Middle English visible, from Old French visible, from Late Latin visibilis (“that may be seen”), from Latin videre (“to see”), past participle
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 visible，经古法语 visible 追溯至晚期拉丁语 visibilis（可以被看见的），源于拉丁语 videre（看）；原文随后提及分词形式……

reviews.en: From Middle English visioun, from Anglo-Norman visioun, from Old French vision, from Latin vīsiō (“vision, seeing”), noun of action from the perfect passive
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 visioun，经盎格鲁—诺曼语 visioun、古法语 vision 追溯至拉丁语 vīsiō（视觉、看）；它是由相关完成被动形式构成的动作名词……

reviews.en: From Middle English visual, from French visuel, visual and directly from Late Latin vīsuālis (“of sight”), from vīsus (“sight, vision”) + -ālis (“adjective
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 visual，借自法语 visuel、visual，也直接受到晚期拉丁语 vīsuālis（与视觉有关的）影响，后者由 vīsus（视力、视觉）与形容词后缀 -ālis 构成……

reviews.en: Learned borrowing from Medieval Latin vocābulārium. Doublet of vocabularium.
reviews.zh: 从中世纪拉丁语 vocābulārium 借入的学术词；与 vocabularium 是同源异形词。

reviews.en: From Middle English vocacioun, from Old French vocation, from Latin vocātiō.
reviews.zh: 来自中古英语 vocacioun，经古法语 vocation 追溯至拉丁语 vocātiō。
